data.Q: Who takes the citizens of Shechem out to face Abimelek?
data.A: Gaal takes the citizens of Shechem out to face Abimelek.
data.wrong_answer: Abimelek takes the citizens of Shechem out to fight.

data.Q: Whom does Abimelek pursue to the gate?
data.A: Abimelek pursues Gaal to the gate.
data.wrong_answer: Abimelek pursues the citizens of Shechem to the gate.

data.Q: Who forces Gaal and his clan to leave Shechem?
data.A: Zebul forces Gaal and his clan to leave Shechem.
data.wrong_answer: Abimelek forces Gaal and his clan to leave Shechem.

data.Q: What does Zebul do after Abimelek stays in Arumah?
data.A: Zebul makes Gaal and his clan leave Shechem.
